# GitHub Copilot Instructions for Vestara

This repository is a multi-package project. The main implementation and development work is inside `vestara-ai-core/`.

## Primary guidance

- Prefer the root `AGENTS.md` file for workspace-specific facts and commands.
- Do not treat `vestara-blueprint/` or other top-level folders as the main codebase; they are design docs and reference material only.
- For code changes and build/test workflows, use `vestara-ai-core/`.

## Useful references

- `AGENTS.md` — root repo guidance and workspace facts.
- `vestara-ai-core/README.md` — quick start and workspace orientation.
- `vestara-ai-core/CONTRIBUTING.md` — development and testing conventions.
- `vestara-ai-core/PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md` — package and app layout.
